triggers.name: campaign_created
triggers.title: Campaign created
triggers.help: Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Mailchimp action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Mailchimp connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: add_subscriber_tag
actions.title: Add subscriber tags
actions.help: Add tags to a list member. If a tag that does not exist is passed, a new tag will be created.

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: Select list to which subscriber tags are to be added.

input.name: email
input.label: Email address
input.hint: Provide list member's email address. For example, john.smith@acme.com

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.hint: Provide name of the tag. For example, Influencer

actions.name: add_subscriber_v3
actions.title: Add subscriber
actions.help: Supports up to 100 custom fields

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: List to which the user should subscribe to

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: If no value provided, the subscriber's status will be subscribed .

actions.name: create_audience
actions.title: Create audience
actions.help: Create a new audience. Requires contact details and campaign defaults Mailchimp mandates.

input.name: email_type_option
input.label: Email type option
input.hint: Whether the audience supports multiple email formats.

actions.name: draft_campaign
actions.title: Draft campaign
actions.help: Create a campaign draft from supplied content. At least one of HTML or plain text is required.

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: Defaults to regular.

actions.name: get_record
actions.title: Get record
actions.help: Get a single audience, or a campaign with its content (and optionally its report).

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the type of record to get.

actions.name: get_subscriber_activity
actions.title: Get subscriber activity
actions.help: Get a member's activity on a specific list, including opens, clicks, and unsubscribes.

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: Select list to monitor activities.

input.name: email
input.label: Email address
input.hint: Provide list member's email address. For example, john.smith@acme.com

input.name: fields
input.label: Fields
input.hint: Select list of fields to return.

input.name: exclude_fields
input.label: Exclude fields
input.hint: Select list of fields to exclude.

input.name: count
input.label: Count
input.hint: Number of records to return. Default value: 10 . Maximum value is 1000 .

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Number of records from a collection to skip. Default value: 0 .

actions.name: get_subscriber_tags
actions.title: Get subscriber tags
actions.help: Get the tags on a list member.

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: Select list from which subscriber tags are to be retrieved.

input.name: email
input.label: Email address
input.hint: Provide list member's email address. For example, john.smith@acme.com

input.name: fields
input.label: Fields
input.hint: Select list of fields to return.

input.name: exclude_fields
input.label: Exclude fields
input.hint: Select list of fields to exclude.

input.name: count
input.label: Count
input.hint: Number of records to return. Default value: 10 . Maximum value is 1000 .

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Number of records from a collection to skip. Default value: 0 .

actions.name: list_records
actions.title: List records
actions.help: List audiences and campaigns, or an audience's activity and growth history.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the type of records to list.

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: List to unsubscribe user from

actions.name: schedule_campaign
actions.title: Schedule campaign
actions.help: Schedule a campaign to send at a future time. Minutes must be 0, 15, 30, or 45 (UTC).

input.name: schedule_time
input.label: Schedule time
input.hint: Future time. Minutes must be 0, 15, 30, or 45 (UTC).

actions.name: search_campaigns
actions.title: Search campaigns
actions.help: Fetch a list of campaigns that match all search criterias provided.

input.name: title
input.label: Campaign name
input.hint: Fetch campaigns with this exact name

input.name: subject
input.label: Email subject
input.hint: Fetch campaigns with this exact email subject

actions.name: search_contacts
actions.title: Search contacts
actions.help: Search the account (or one audience) for contacts by email or name. Returns contacts in all statuses.

input.name: query
input.label: Search text
input.hint: A valid email address, or text matching a contact's first or last name.

input.name: audience_id
input.label: Audience
input.hint: Restrict the search to one audience; leave blank to search the whole account.

properties.name: consents_to_one_to_one_messaging
properties.label: Consents to one to one messaging

actions.name: search_subscribers
actions.title: Search subscribers
actions.help: Fetch a list of subscribers with email address partially matched to the text provided.

input.name: query
input.label: Search text
input.hint: Search text should match to the subscriber's email address partially.

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: List to search subscribers from.

actions.name: search_tags
actions.title: Search tags
actions.help: Search for tags on a list in Mailchimp.

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: Select list from which subscriber tags should be retrieved.

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.hint: All tags that have a name starting with the provided value will be returned.

actions.name: send_campaign
actions.title: Send campaign
actions.help: Send a campaign immediately to its target list. This is irreversible.

actions.name: send_test
actions.title: Send test campaign
actions.help: Send a test email of a campaign to specified addresses. Does not send to the campaign's list. The campaign must not already be sent.

input.name: test_emails
input.label: Test emails
input.hint: Email addresses to receive the test.

input.name: send_type
input.label: Send type
input.hint: Defaults to html.

actions.name: tag_contact
actions.title: Tag contact
actions.help: Add or remove tags on a contact. Set each tag's status to active to add or inactive to remove.

input.name: is_syncing
input.label: Is syncing
input.hint: If true, automations based on the tags will not fire.

actions.name: unschedule_campaign
actions.title: Unschedule campaign
actions.help: Cancel the schedule of a campaign that has not started sending. Mailchimp returns the campaign to a draft or paused state, so read the returned status rather than assuming it becomes a draft.

actions.name: update_campaign
actions.title: Update campaign
actions.help: Update a campaign's subject, sender, or recipient audience. From name and reply-to are required.

actions.name: update_contact
actions.title: Update contact
actions.help: Partially update an existing contact in an audience. Does not create the contact if absent.

output.name: consents_to_one_to_one_messaging
output.label: Consents to one to one messaging

actions.name: update_subscriber_v3
actions.title: Update subscriber
actions.help: Supports up to 100 custom fields

input.name: id
input.label: List
input.hint: List to which the user should subscribe to

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: If no value provided, the subscriber's status will be retained as same.

actions.name: upsert_contact
actions.title: Upsert contact
actions.description: Add or update a contact in a MailChimp audience
actions.help: Add or update (upsert) a contact in an audience with a subscription status. If the contact already exists, it is updated.

input.name: status
input.label: Status
input.hint: Defaults to subscribed. Use subscribed only with prior consent; otherwise pending sends a double opt-in confirmation.

input.name: tags
input.label: Tags
input.hint: Tags to apply on creation.

output.name: consents_to_one_to_one_messaging
output.label: Consents to one to one messaging
